title: German Silky Pasta with Fennel Cream
description: A silky, herbal German dish featuring sashimi-cut vermicelli pasta and pan-seared trout, perfect for a crowd-pleaser dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the vermicelli pasta until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp of butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the sliced fennel until softened.
Add the remaining 2 tbsp of butter, heavy cream, lemon juice, and furikake seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the fennel cream with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pat the trout fillets dry with paper towels and season with salt and black pepper.
Add the trout fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Drain the cooked vermicelli pasta and add it to the skillet with the fennel cream and trout.
Toss the pasta to combine with the fennel cream and trout, then serve immediately.
Garnish with additional sliced fennel and furikake seasoning, if desired.
